 Kyle Pitts Sr. Week 9 Outlook - Bengals at Falcons 
 By Derek Brown (FantasyPros) , Thu, Nov 5th 2026, 1:35pm EST 
 Since Week 5, Kyle Pitts has been the TE6 in fantasy points per game. In those four games, Pitts has had a 66.9% route share, a 17.5% target share, 1.40 YPRR, six red zone targets, and a 21.2% first-read share. Cincy still can't stop tight ends. They have been hopeless against them, which makes Pitts a strong start this week with huge upside. In their last five games, Cincy has allowed the most yards per target and the second-most receiving yards to tight ends.
